verdict.rationale: jo is a natural-language personal agent: its docs say users ask it to build and publish websites and then change them conversationally. It is reachable by natural language across macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp and email, and it handles messages, schedules, projects and issue creation through connected context. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, and in-depth documentation of command scope and limits beyond the marketing and llms.txt snippets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can ask jo to build and publish a real website, then change it conversationally.
jo speaks on macOS (native app), Telegram, WhatsApp, and email — same memory and context across all of them.
jo works with your connected context to help with the messages, schedules, projects, and follow-ups you are carrying.
you can ask jo to publish a personal site, or a page for any project (e.g. a family trip). jo keeps it current as things change.
